name: Password reset token with insufficient entropy
description:
The part of the application's password reset tokens that changes from one token to the next is short enough to try every value: burpsy computed the keyspace from several tokens issued to a test identity and found at most a million values. Unless every confirm attempt is throttled and the token expires within minutes, an attacker can request a reset for a victim and guess the token online.

This row is burpsy's own: Burp's issue catalogue has no password-reset rows.
remediation: Use reset tokens with at least 128 bits from a cryptographically secure random source. If a short code is required for usability, bind it to the requesting session, limit attempts per token and per account, and expire it within minutes.

references.title: OWASP WSTG: Testing for Weak Password Change or Reset Functionalities (WSTG-ATHN-09)

vulnerabilityClassifications.title: CWE-640: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password
